children.text: Visit the nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) in your locality.
Obtain the scheme enrollment form from the Anganwadi Worker (AWW).
Fill in the details in the form with attach the required documents.
Submit the filled form and documents to the AWC.
The Anganwadi Worker verifies the eligibility and registers the applicant under MSPY – Maternal Nutrition.
Beneficiary receives acknowledgement of enrolment and is included in the monthly THR distribution list.
On the 1st of every month, the AWW distributes the entitled THR packages (Til Ladoo, Chana, Paushtik Bhel, Dates) at the AWC.
Health services such as ANC check-ups, IFA and Calcium supplementation continue as per schedule.

schemeContent.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide supplementary Take Home Ration (THR) in the form of nutrient-rich food products to pregnant women and lactating mothers across the state.

children.text: The “Maternal Nutrition” scheme is a component under the "Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana (MSPY)" scheme, introduced by the Department of Women & Child Development, Government of Odisha. The scheme aims to provide supplementary Take Home Ration (THR) in the form of nutrient-rich food products to pregnant women and lactating mothers across the state. Additionally, essential services such as antenatal care (ANC) check-ups during Mamata Diwas, immunisation, and IFA and calcium supplementation are also provided. The scheme has been implemented for a five-year period, commencing from FY 2023-24 to FY 2027-28.
